risk_scoring_model.scoring_notes: Scores are assigned on a 1‑10 scale per dimension; overall risk is the arithmetic mean of the four dimensions.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Successful login redirects to dashboard within performance threshold
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Login success is a core flow but failure has limited business and user impact; likelihood of failure is low and no security concerns.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Email format validation shows appropriate error
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: UI validation errors have minimal business effect; they are unlikely to cause security issues.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Password field masking persists across platforms
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Masking affects usability and minor security perception; risk remains low.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Generic error message displayed for incorrect credentials
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Improper error messages could expose authentication logic and affect user experience; moderate likelihood.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Brute‑force lockout after configurable failed attempts
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Lockout mechanism is critical for protecting accounts; failure can lead to account takeover or denial of service.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Login over TLS and no sensitive data logged
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Transport security and data leakage are high‑impact concerns; any breach would be severe.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Login response time under load remains within SLA
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Performance degradation can affect user satisfaction and revenue; likelihood under load is moderate.
